ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation CDD/EDD screening of all directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners against the Samoan AML/CFT PEP database, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions Lists, FATF public statements and high-risk jurisdiction lists; enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification required for any PEP or sanctioned-country nexus; screening must be conducted by the SIFA-licensed registered agent and evidenced in the AML/CFT compliance file available to the Central Bank of Samoa.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Registry of International Companies (electronic filing channel operated through SIFA-licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name of an International Company must be in English and rendered in Roman/Latin script; a Chinese-script name may be adopted only as a non-statutory secondary brand name; all Chinese-language constituent documents must be accompanied by a certified English translation filed with the Registrar.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended by filing a written extension request with the Registry before expiry, subject to the continued availability of the name. Upon refusal, the applicant, through its SIFA-licensed registered agent, may deliver a written Notice of Appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal; the Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 days of receipt. A further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 14 days of the Registrar's final determination. A fresh name clearance application may also be submitted where grounds for refusal are cured.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for back-office and digital operations only; the International Company must at all times maintain a physical registered office at the premises of a SIFA-licensed registered agent in Samoa, and the equity crowdfunding portal must maintain a compliant operational presence and data access point in Samoa under the conditions of the special license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 40% quantified risk of an unannounced on-site inspection by the Central Bank of Samoa or SIFA within the first 12 months due to the High_Risk_Special_License classification of an equity crowdfunding portal.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; ss. 6-9 (Incorporation by Registration), s. 13 (Registered Office), s. 19 (Directors), s. 21 (Secretary), s. 128 (Exempt Company Status)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under the International Companies Act 1987; share capital may be denominated in any currency and issued at par or no-par value. No escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association submitted to the Registrar be and are hereby adopted; that the subscribers' shares be allotted as recorded in the register of members; that the registered office be fixed at the office of the Company's licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; that the offices of Director and Secretary be conferred upon the persons named in the register of directors; that the Directors be authorized to open bank accounts, appoint professional advisors, and file all statutory forms; and RESOLVED FURTHER that the Directors be authorized to apply to the Samoa International Financial Authority for all licences required for the Company's equity crowdfunding operations and to execute all incidental instruments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies / MCIL (via SIFA-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability inquiry to the Registrar through the appointed licensed registered agent. The proposed name must be distinguishable from all existing local and international company names and must not bear restricted words (e.g., 'bank', 'trust', 'assurance') unless the appropriate licence is obtained. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 90 days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (Permit of Name application)
Identity details of the intended shareholder(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or reservation is incomplete, submit an alternative name via the same registered agent; limited appeals are made to the Registrar by written submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent / Samoan legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including permitted 'exempt company' declarations under s.128 of the Act, share class provisions, director appointment mechanisms, indemnity clauses, and the registered agent consent. The subscriber(s) execute the M&A before witnesses (or by legalization if executed remotely).
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified copy of passport of subscriber(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Counsel issues a drafting requisition response to the Registrar; any non-compliant clauses are amended and re-executed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia (submission window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed M&A, Form IC-1, and the statutory declaration of compliance at the MCIL Companies Office and pays the government filing fee (approximately USD 100) together with agent fees. Required notice of registered office and first directors follows with the incorporation package.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance by a subscriber/director
Notice of registered office and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registry will issue a requisition; the registered agent files the curative response within 30 days, with amended forms or clarification affidavits as appropriate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and certifies the M&A. The company then files its register of directors/secretary, register of members, and registered agent acceptance form with the Registrar to complete the statutory books.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the certificate are corrected by formal application to the Registrar with affidavit evidence and payment of the correction fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Corporate Governance and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (registered office in Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial director(s) convene the first board meeting (physical or virtual), adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, approve the issue of subscriber shares, open bank accounts via the registered agent, adopt a common seal (if desired), and approve the AML/CFT policy framework for the crowdfunding operations.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms / AML onboarding pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect discovered in corporate records is ratified by a subsequent board resolution; no government remedy is required for purely internal governance acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Special Financial Services Licence Application (Crowdfunding Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the SIFA international financial services licence application with the corporate formation package, business plan, fit-and-proper declarations, AML/CFT compliance manual, and capital adequacy evidence. A 'high-risk special licence' review is applied to crowdfunding due to the AML risk tier; the applicant must also designate a compliance officer.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified M&A
Business plan for the equity crowdfunding portal
Fit-and-proper declarations for all directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a deficiency letter, respond within 30 days with the requested information; material amendments to the AML/CFT framework may be resubmitted without a new application fee during the review window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Financial Services (Crowdfunding Portal) Special Licence

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - EIA Registration/Screening (office-based, low-impact digital intermediary; no full EIA Report required for administrative office use)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge; discharges must comply with the Samoa Water Quality Standards; any standby generator emissions must meet ambient air quality limits; e-waste and used office equipment to be handled under the Waste Management Regulations and exported only with written approval of PUMA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); structural/occupational clearance from the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (building permit and occupancy verification) and compliance with the Ministry of Labour's occupational safety audit; quarantine/health clearance is not applicable to an office-based digital portal.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa — official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws; International Company incorporation and license administration: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Registrar of International Companies
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Submit TIN-1 registration form, certified passport copy, Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and certified registered office confirmation to MfR by email (registration@revenue.gov.ws) or in person at MfR headquarters, Apia; 2) MfR issues the TIN within 5 business days; 3) Foreign-owned International Companies are not required to appoint a local tax resident agent but must maintain a registered office in Samoa; 4) ICs with no Samoan-source income remain exempt from income tax but must file an annual information declaration to maintain good standing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Check-the-box-style election: an International Company may irrevocably elect under the International Companies Act 1987 s. 18 to convert to a local company governed by the Companies Act 2006, thereby exiting the tax-exempt regime and becoming subject to the standard 27% corporate income tax rate; separate voluntary VAT registration election is available below the statutory WST 100,000 turnover threshold for entities making taxable supplies to Samoa-resident customers.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (Value Added Tax Act 2017, s. 14)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No statutory e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate in force. Paper or PDF invoices are legally acceptable; there is no API clearance system, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control requirement in Samoa as of the current tax year.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (a) export of goods evidenced by customs departure records; (b) supply of services to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply, including crowd-funding platform and commission services invoiced by the portal to non-resident Issuers; (c) services directly connected with international transport. An equity crowdfunding portal billing overseas startup Issuers outside Samoa satisfies the place-of-supply test and may claim 0% VAT, provided the issuer is not registered for VAT in Samoa and no local beneficiary exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs online CED)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or commercial bank credit proof of funds received in Samoa
VAT zero-rated invoice signed by the supplier
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MfR audit under the Tax Administration Act 2012 permits retrospective assessment up to 4 years (10 years in cases of fraud or wilful default). Wrongful zero-rating claims trigger shortfall penalties of 50% of the VAT undercharged for unintentional error and 150% for intentional or reckless conduct, plus late payment interest of 10% per annum. Wilful evasion is a criminal offense punishable by fine up to WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years; for International Companies, SIFA may additionally revoke the international company license and cancel registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) operates under a partial-convertibility regime. Current-account payments for genuine trade and service transactions are generally permitted without prior approval. Capital-account transactions, including cross-border equity crowdfunding inflows and outbound profit or dividend remittances, require prior exchange-control consent from the Central Bank of Samoa. Profit and capital repatriation by a Samoa International Company is permissible after the company is in good standing with the Registry of International Companies, has settled any Samoa tax liabilities (which are normally nil under a tax-exempt IC structure), and has obtained an exchange-control release where the remittance exceeds a bank's threshold. In practice, banks require documentary evidence of the underlying investment deal, investor KYC files, and a certificate of compliance from the corporate administrator before wiring funds offshore.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and Central Bank of Samoa regulations, residents must repatriate export proceeds to a licensed Samoa bank within 30 days of shipment, and any proceeds retained in a foreign currency must be sold to an authorised dealer for Samoan tala at the prevailing exchange rate within the same period unless the Central Bank of Samoa grants a foreign-currency retention allowance. Non-resident International Companies are normally outside the resident surrender obligation; however, a Samoa-resident operating branch, any Samoa employee, or an entity generating commercial revenue in-country would be required to comply fully with the repatriation and conversion timeline.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital electronic-money institutions (EMIs) are not licensed banks in Samoa and cannot hold the regulatory escrow capital required for an equity crowdfunding portal. A foreign EMI or neobank offering virtual accounts and remote wire clearing would be treated as an unregulated service provider by the Samoa Financial Services Authority and would create immediate high-risk AML flags. Local bank connectivity via correspondent bank networks, not digital EMIs, is the only legally sound clearing and escrow route.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a high-risk equity crowdfunding portal, all directors, ultimate beneficial owners, and the designated AML compliance officer must attend a physical KYC interview at the chosen Samoa-licensed bank or before the bank's approved lawful attorney in Samoa. Remote-only onboarding is not accepted unless the bank has a binding correspondent-bank KYC arrangement with the introducer, and even then the final account-opening decision is reserved by the local compliance committee. Physical presence remains the prudential norm for a newly formed International Company with non-resident ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Portal is engaged in equity crowdfunding but does not demonstrate a specific financial-services licence in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of licensing or registration issued by the Samoa Financial Services Authority for the equity crowdfunding activity, the platform's constitutional documents and operating rules, a legal opinion confirming the activity falls within ISIC 6499 / its Samoa regulatory perimeter, and the platform's anti-money-laundering policy manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure uses nominee directors, bearer shares, or incomplete beneficial ownership details.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Register of directors and shareholders, a current beneficial-ownership declaration filed with the Samoa Registry of International Companies, certified copies of passport and proof of address for every natural-person director and owner, a no-bearer-shares confirmation, and a corporate administrative due-diligence report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound remittances from a crowd of small unrelated investors appear as structured deposits or potential money-mule activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated transaction-monitoring reports showing full source-of-funds scoring, per-investor identity and suitability checks, investor whitelisting for the specific crowdfunding campaign, daily transaction-limit parameters, and a live dashboard shared with the bank's compliance unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Escrowed funds may be disbursed rapidly to third-party issuers or related parties before agreed funding milestones.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed escrow agreement between the platform, the bank, and the issuer, milestone verification procedures, issuer KYC files, periodic audit trails of funding campaign settlement, and written confirmation that disbursement is conditional on independently verified metrics.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Investor funds are received in the capital escrow account at a Samoa-licensed commercial bank solely through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 inbound wires originating from the investor's own bank account or licensed payment account. Wires must be directed to the designated escrow bank account in Samoa with the relevant exchange-control purpose code agreed with Central Bank of Samoa, such as the code for direct investment in equity or securities. The bank will verify the investor's identity, the subscription documentation, and the matching project commitment before applying the necessary FX conversion from the foreign currency into WST or maintaining the asset at the confirmed foreign-currency equivalent. All inbound remittances are subject to the platform's AML screening, investor suitability assessment, and the bank's source-of-funds check; no digital-asset or crypto rails are permitted.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements from escrow to approved issuers after the funding campaign reaches its target are executed through SWIFT MT103 beneficiary-credit transfers to the issuer's professional bank account. In cases involving large procurement or raw-material purchases, a commercial letter of credit can be issued through the Samoa bank's correspondent network, typically by MT700, covering documents against payment. Disbursement of residual refunds to unsuccessful campaigns is also routed by SWIFT MT103 to the original investor's account or to a nominated refund processor trusted by the bank. No cash clearance or third-party bearer instrument may be used.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright WST/USD forward contracts booked with a Central Bank of Samoa-licensed commercial bank, supported by real underlying transaction exposure and full documentary evidence.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on WST/USD entered with a reputable offshore counterparty via a Samoa-authorized dealer, with structurally net settlement and no Samoa domestic delivery leg.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps, but only with prior consent of the Central Bank of Samoa, a licensed Samoa bank as intermediary, and documented underlying commercial debt exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Renewal for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the incorporation date; first-year license is prepaid at incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers an automatic statutory late-payment surcharge of WST 800 (approximately USD 290) under the International Companies Act 2012. Arrears outstanding 90 days past the anniversary due date expose the company to a Gazette notice of intended strike-off and administrative dissolution after a further 3 months. Directors may be assessed personal liability for renewal arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the incorporation date (the filing date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Annual return filed more than 30 days after the anniversary incurs a Registrar-imposed late filing fee of WST 800 (approximately USD 290). Persistent non-filing for consecutive cycles constitutes a contravention of the International Companies Act 2012, leads to suspension of the registered agent's endorsement, and authorizes the Registrar to strike the company off after Gazette notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Equity Crowdfunding Portal Financial Services Authorization
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (regulatory oversight of securities intermediaries) and MCIL International Financial Services Centre (offshore permit coordination)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the same anniversary cycle as the International Company renewal; authorization validity is conditioned on payment of the annual supervisory fee and submission of the updated compliance certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The portal's financial-services authorization lapses immediately if renewal is unpaid. Continued operation without current authorization is an offense under Samoa's securities and AML/CFT legislation, punishable by fines of up to WST 100,000 (approximately USD 36,000), escrow account restrictions, and possible revocation of the equity crowdfunding license by the Central Bank of Samoa.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to Samoa International Companies. An audit is required only where (i) the Supreme Court orders an audit on application by the Registrar, a shareholder, or a creditor; (ii) the Registrar or AML authority requires audited financial statements during an economic-substance or money-laundering investigation; or (iii) the company's articles mandate an annual shareholder-approved audit. A licensed equity crowdfunding portal must retain independent escrow reports but is not subject to a general statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies must keep accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and fairly reflect financial position. Records may be maintained under IFRS or any comparable recognized GAAP, in any currency, and may be stored outside Samoa without filing financial statements with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register with the Registrar of International Companies. Shareholding movements are memorialized by updating the Register of Members at the registered office, and the Beneficial Ownership Register must be amended and filed with the Registrar within 14 days of any transfer or change in control. On each incorporation anniversary the registered agent submits the annual UBO confirmation and pays the UBO registry maintenance fee. For the equity crowdfunding portal, the annual UBO confirmation must be accompanied by refreshed fitness-and-propriety declarations for all shareholders holding 10% or more and for signatories of the client escrow account.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 - 1,800 per annum for registered office maintenance, licensed resident registered agent, corporate secretarial support, and UBO register processing
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Exempt from mandatory audit; voluntary certified audit ranges from USD 2,500 - 6,000 if commissioned by shareholders or investors

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Companies (ICs) incorporated under Samoa's International Companies Act 1987; the resident domestic company headline rate is 27% if IC tax-exempt status is lost or domestic Samoan-source business is conducted.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective income tax rate. ICs are statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, estate duty, inheritance tax, and exchange control requirements. Dividends, interest, royalties, and rental income received or paid by the IC are outside the Samoan tax net. A small annual government fee is payable instead. No general tax-loss relief mechanism operates because no taxable income is produced by an IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required. The only filing obligation is the 'Annual Return of International Company' lodged through the Samoa Companies Registry eServices portal maintained by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL). A licensed registered agent in Samoa must file on behalf of the IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 30 days after each anniversary date of incorporation. No quarterly CIT instalment or income tax prepayment applies to an International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, registration number, and date of incorporation of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact English or romanised registered name and the WS/IC registration number issued by MCIL. The non-resident beneficial owner must instruct the registered agent to ensure that the entity is presented as a current, active IC and not as a shell or dormant structure without substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Particulars of directors, company secretary, registered office, registered agent, and the shareholding structure including share classes and beneficial ownership declarations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must declare nominee versus beneficial ownership separately. Attach a beneficial ownership declaration where the equity crowdfunding platform is controlled by non-resident founders, and keep a updated register of members in Samoa for inspection by the Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC carried on no taxable activity in Samoa, earned no Samoan-source domestic income, and did not trade within Samoa during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the crowdfunding portal solicits Samoan resident investors, issues equity to Samoan residents, or performs material management functions in Samoa, the IC may be deemed to carry on trade in Samoa and could lose its exempt status. In that case, the entity must file a full Samoan corporate income tax return on taxable profits immediately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Regulatory licence details: Central Bank of Samoa financial services licence, Special Crowdfunding Portal licence reference, and AML/CFT compliance certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a copy of the special licence and confirm the AML compliance officer and audit report are available in Samoa. Non-resident portal operators must also update the FIU granted compliance records before the annual return is certified.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a late penalty of WST 500 per month or part of a month, plus WST 100 for each day after a formal demand notice. Continued failure can result in automatic strike-off from the International Companies Register, publication in the Government Gazette, and restoration costs payable personally by the registered agent or director.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — dividends paid by a Samoan International Company to non-resident shareholders are statutorily exempt from Samoan withholding tax under the International Companies Act 1987. No deduction, withholding, or reporting of Samoan dividend WHT is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because the domestic statutory rate is 0%, no DTA claim is needed for ordinary IC dividends. If the entity is later reclassified as a resident taxable company, treaty relief must be invoked by: (1) applying to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue for a Tax Residency Certificate in Form R1; (2) submitting a certified copy of the TRC to the payer before each distribution; (3) providing a DTA article analysis showing entitlement to the reduced rate; and (4) obtaining the payor's tax authority confirmation where the DTA requires a competent-authority procedure. Samoa has comprehensive double taxation agreements with Australia, New Zealand, and Norway; no separate PRC-Samoa income tax treaty applies to equity crowdfunding flows.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: For an exempt International Company, cross-border royalty and interest payments are subject to 0% Samoan withholding tax. In the domestic resident corporate regime, non-resident interest and royalty withholding tax is 15%; under Samoa's DTAs, treaty rates may be reduced to approximately 10% for interest and 5% for royalties, subject to beneficial ownership and limitation-of-benefits conditions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 10,000,000 annual gross turnover is the threshold that triggers mandatory Local File and Master File preparation for companies within the Samoan income tax net. International Companies that remain tax-exempt have no direct TP documentation obligation, but if the crowdfunding portal operates through a related Samoan taxable subsidiary or the IC is reclassified as taxable, contemporaneous Local File and Master File documentation must be prepared once connected-party transactions exceed WST 10,000,000 in annual turnover.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has not introduced a general Economic Substance Regulations regime for standard International Companies. However, the International Companies Act 1987, the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, and Central Bank of Samoa licensing practice require a meaningful presence in Samoa: a registered office, a licensed registered agent, board minutes, adequate books and records, and a local AML compliance arrangement for high-risk crowdfunding activity. Without this substance, authorities may treat the IC as a shell and deny the zero-tax exemption or revoke the crowdfunding portal licence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on a Samoan-source equity crowdfunding or investor-payment business while continuing to claim International Company tax-exempt status; structuring commissions, referral fees, or dividends as non-taxable IC distributions and failing to register for Samoan corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of Samoan corporate income tax at 27% on all undeclared profits, recapture of 15% withholding tax on hidden distributions, and a fraudulent evasion penalty of up to 200% of the unpaid tax under the Income Tax Act 2012 and the Tax Administration Act 2012. Criminal prosecution may result in a fine of up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment for up to seven years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, nominee shareholders, and the registered agent may be held jointly and severally liable for the tax, penalty, and interest where the IC acted as a mere instrumentality without separate commercial substance. The Samoan court can pierce the corporate veil, issue civil restitution orders, impose travel bans, and order passport surrender pending full payment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the equity crowdfunding portal through a shell International Company with no office, no employees, no local records, and only nominee directors; marketing the IC as a licensed crowdfunding intermediary without the Central Bank of Samoa special licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the International Company certificate, cancellation of the financial services licence, automatic strike-off after 90 days, and a monetary penalty of WST 50,000 under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors who knowingly signed false declarations are personally liable for the penalty and costs; a court may impose a five-year disqualification from acting as a director in Samoa, and any director attempting to leave Samoa while liabilities remain is subject to a departure prohibition order.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to conduct customer due diligence, beneficial ownership verification, transaction monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting on equity crowdfunding investors; accepting anonymous deposits via ACH escrow or bank wire without source-of-funds verification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to WST 1,000,000 for a body corporate and WST 300,000 for an individual, together with forfeiture of transaction proceeds, under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and directions issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit. Regulatory revocation of the crowdfunding licence follows automatically.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in or direct money laundering activities are personally criminally liable and may be imprisoned; personal assets may be restrained by court order, and removal from the director register is mandatory upon conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting an International Company annual return containing false particulars, failing to disclose a change of beneficial owner, or certifying a tax-exempt status while the portal is in fact soliciting Samoan resident retail investors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of WST 10,000 plus a daily penalty of WST 200 until corrected; the court may impose imprisonment for up to two years for knowingly furnishing a false return to the Samoan Companies Registry or the Ministry of Revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent are jointly and severally liable for investor losses caused by misstatement; civil restitution orders may compel repayment of funds raised without disclosure, and personal travel bans remain in force until the court order is fully satisfied.
